en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a tall column and statue in a city square. Atop the column stands a figure; at its base is a sculpted winged figure beside a standing man on a pedestal inscribed "ADAM MICKIEWICZ". Behind the monument are multi‑story 19th‑century buildings with shops on the ground floor. Several people gather around the monument in the foreground. The lower margin bears printed captions in Polish and German identifying the scene.
